constraints.subject: tuf.*
constraints.justification: ADR-0001 chooses Python 3.6+ only; Python 2.7 is named as end-of-life and explicitly rejected

constraints.subject: tuf.*
constraints.justification: ADR-0001 chooses Python 3.6+ only; Python 3.5 is named as end-of-life and explicitly rejected

note: Process/location ADR: 'develop TUF 1.0.0 in a subdirectory' is a development process decision, not an enforceable code-level architectural constraint. Emit no edges.

constraints.subject: tuf.api.metadata.*
constraints.justification: ADR-0006 separates serialization from the metadata class model; metadata classes depend on the serialization package (tuf.api.serialization), not the other way around

constraints.subject: tuf.repository.*
constraints.justification: ADR-0010 states the repository library is built on top of the Metadata API; this is a dependency, not an inheritance rule

note: Do NOT emit requires_implementation tuf.repository._repository.Repository: ADR describes Repository as an ABC that may be extended by choice, not a base that all repository classes must implement. 'Built on top of' = requires_dependency.
